desc:
"There Are Times When You Can't Give Up."
- Draken

Welcome To Revengers Dispute a game based off the popular Manga/Anime Tokyo Revengers.

There is little to no hand holding in this game.

This Is A Fighting Game And A Lore Based Game.

⚠️ GAME IS IN ALPHA! Be aware there will be some bugs. You have been warned.

🕹️Controls:
[M] - Menu
[X] - Check For Gym Membership
[B] - Grip
[V] - Carry
[WW] - Sprint
[Right-Shift] - Open/Close Phone
[Space] - Climb

🔮Make Sure To Join Communications To Get News About Events and Updates!
